title: Awesome!
text: Magnificent day, stunning scenery. Antonio, our guide is very experienced and passionate about the local history and took great care of us. Highly recommended!
author: R7726FKscottp

title: Antonio’s Andorra
text: We had the pleasure of taking a day trip from Barcelona to Andorra with our wonderful guide Antonio.  His knowledge and insights spanning history, language, politics and sports made for an informative and enjoyable day.  His choice for a lunch spot was tailor made for our tastes and provided a perfect slice of Andorran life.  We would not hesitate to book with him any time we are in the area.
author: Kelly_B

title: Tailored & Customized
text: Tailored, customized to what our interests were. Antonio is knoledgable and passionate about this region and it shows.
author: jonathanbM8946PQ

title: This was amazing day - learned and saw so much; worth an investing the time!
text:
Yes this is a long day
yes, you get to add Andorra to your country list
But what you may not expect is a really full and engaging experience. We love history and it was provided all day.  Great overview but also stops that were tailored to our interests.  Highly recommend!
author: Diane_B

title: A great day trip to the Pyrenees and Andorra
text: Our tour guide Antonio was excellent. Very knowledgeable about Andorra (and the whole area between Barcelona and Andorra). The day was uncharacteristically snowy - especially for March - but Antonio managed to get us around safely and we still saw many sights throughout our tour. Interesting churches, beautiful vantage points and a chance to see the picturesque towns of Andorra. This was what we wanted.
author: JENNIFER_R

title: Excellent
text: Antonio was a great guide. Andora is about 3 hours from Barcelona but worth it. We liked this tour because tour was personalized to us. We visited several towns. He is very informative on the history and we learned a lot. There is a lot to see but this gives you a quick snapshot off the country. We stopped for lunch at a beautiful restaurant and had som Andorran dishes. Highly recommend.

title: My Bucket List Item!
text: This was on my Bucket List since I was 12 years old!   I am so glad we did it, and having Sebastian was great. He was very accommodating and easy going.  I would highly recommend...and he is also a warehouse of stories and information.  We enjoyed his company...which is nice when you have a 3 hour trip!
author: Carrie_H

title: Ivana is the best person to show you Andorra. Ivana is a fantastic customer service and good listener.
text:
Ivana, our guide and the car operator made the whole trip excellent.  She was very punctual and extremely knowledgeable of what to see where to eat. She knew lots of historical facts. She knew this area between Spain and Andorra very well. She was very sweet, caring, and always trying her best to accommodate our request ad she did. 
The only tiny suggestion I have to the tour operator is please provide big car with comfortable seats, as I and my family were tall people the car was very small and my back started hurting after some time.
